title: 蹄鉄ならイクノにおまかせ！

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Check it out, you guys! I just got these new Super Deluxe ☆ Turbo Rainbow cleats!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wowiee! They're so sparkly and shiny.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: You should add lights to yours too, Machitan. Then you can jet off to victory at turbo speed!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I-interesting! Maybe that way I won't be a normie anymore!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Could we all just settle down? Come here for a moment, you two…

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Listen. Flashy accessories aren't going to make you faster. If anything, they'll slow you down and prevent you from running at your best.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Don't choose based on looks. Instead, choose the cleats best suited to your legs and work your way up from there.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: With appropriate, routine care, you can reduce the risk of injury and—are you even listening to me?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I am… I knew this was too good to be true…

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I just… I just wanna look cooool…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oh dear, you've upset them. What will you do now?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Well, it's the teacher's responsibility to motivate their students. So…

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I'll give one stamp for every day you take proper care of your cleats.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: And if you collect enough stamps, you get some colorful spider-shaped candy.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Colorful!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Spiders!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I see your angle here. You were never a teacher, but a mother.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Well, if I'm the mother, you're their elder sister. You'll give me a hand with them, right?

text_block_list.name: Turbo & Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: Let's get those candies, Big Sis!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Sigh… I can't handle a family like this.
